children: Germany's largest union, IG Metall, opposes any attempts by Volkswagen to unwind a large restructuring pact struck in 2024, one of its leading representatives said, days before a crucial board meeting where further cuts could be decided.

"I can only warn you: If the board tries to call this agreement into question again, then the factory floors will be up in arms at all our sites," Thorsten Groeger told workers at a staff gathering in Hanover.
"We will oppose it with all our might."

Volkswagen's supervisory board will meet on Friday to vote on what currently are three rival restructuring proposals, raising the chances of a full escalation that could result in an extraordinary shareholder meeting.

title: IG Metall warns of maximum resistance in turnaround dispute with Volkswagen
